Message: PDF version 1.4 supports standard accessibility features.
Remediation: Ensure the PDF is created with compliant PDF 1.7 or 2.0 specifications without syntax corruption.

Message: Document is not encrypted; accessibility content extraction is unrestricted.
Remediation: Ensure the PDF is created with compliant PDF 1.7 or 2.0 specifications without syntax corruption.

Message: All 3 font(s) in the document are embedded.
Remediation: Embed all fonts when exporting the PDF from your authoring tool (e.g. Word, InDesign) or in Adobe Acrobat Preflight.

Message: Font 'AAAAAA+Arial-BoldMT' lacks an explicit /ToUnicode mapping stream.
Remediation: Convert font to OpenType/TrueType with explicit Unicode mappings before exporting to PDF.

Message: Font 'AAAAAA+ArialMT' lacks an explicit /ToUnicode mapping stream.
Remediation: Convert font to OpenType/TrueType with explicit Unicode mappings before exporting to PDF.

Message: Document is explicitly marked as a Tagged PDF with a structure tree.
Evidence: Catalog/MarkInfo/Marked is true and StructTreeRoot exists.
Remediation: In Acrobat Pro, open Accessibility tool and select 'Add Tags to Document', or check 'Document is tagged PDF' in Word/InDesign export settings.

Message: All pages with text content are associated with the structure tree.
Remediation: Inspect untagged elements in the PDF structure pane and tag them or mark them as background artifacts.

Message: No non-conforming embedded files detected in the document.
Remediation: Ensure attached files are in accessible formats or provide an accessible alternative description.

Message: Document primary natural language is specified as 'en-US'.
Remediation: In Adobe Acrobat Pro, open File > Properties > Advanced > Reading Options, and select the correct Language (e.g. English US).

Message: All 0 element-level language override(s) have valid BCP 47 codes.
Remediation: Select the foreign-language text span in Acrobat Pro's Tag Tree, open Properties, and set the Language attribute.

Message: Structure tree has a compliant top-level structural container.
Remediation: Ensure the root of the structure tree is tagged as Document or Part in Acrobat Pro Tag Tree.

Message: All structural lists, tables, and container elements conform to standard nesting rules.
Remediation: Fix nesting in the Tag Tree so lists contain LI, tables contain TR, and TR contains TH/TD.

Message: Empty structure element <H1> has no child tags or marked content.
Remediation: Remove empty tags in the tag tree.

Message: All custom structure types are properly mapped to standard structure types.
Remediation: Open the Role Map in Acrobat Pro (Tags Panel > Options > Edit Role Map) and map custom tags to standard PDF tags.

Message: No graphical figures or formulas found in the document.
Remediation: In Acrobat Pro, right-click Figure tag > Properties > Tag tab > Alternative Text, and enter a descriptive alternative.

Message: XMP metadata stream is present.
Remediation: In Adobe Acrobat Pro, open File > Properties > Description, enter a Title, and in Preflight run 'Fix PDF/UA identifier'.

Message: Document Title is defined: 'Annual Accessibility and Technology Report 2026'.
Remediation: In Adobe Acrobat Pro, open File > Properties > Description, enter a Title, and in Preflight run 'Fix PDF/UA identifier'.

Message: Document declares PDF/UA compliance (Part 1).
Remediation: In Adobe Acrobat Pro, open File > Properties > Description, enter a Title, and in Preflight run 'Fix PDF/UA identifier'.

Message: DisplayDocTitle is set to true in ViewerPreferences.
Remediation: In Acrobat Pro, open File > Properties > Initial View, and under 'Window Options' set 'Show' to 'Document Title' instead of 'File Name'.

Message: Page tab navigation conforms to document structure order.
Evidence: Tab order is set to Structure (/Tabs /S) across pages.
Remediation: In Acrobat Pro, open File > Properties > Initial View, and under 'Window Options' set 'Show' to 'Document Title' instead of 'File Name'.

Message: No non-text content (images, figures) found in the document.
Remediation: Add descriptive alternative text to all non-decorative images and figures.

Message: No time-based multimedia or audio/video streams detected.
Remediation: Provide synchronized captions or text transcripts for embedded media.

Message: Document contains 1 structured heading element(s).
Remediation: Ensure headings, tables, and lists use appropriate structural tags.

Message: Verify color contrast (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text) and ensure color is not the only means of conveying information.
Evidence: Color contrast requires visual sampling or human verification.
Remediation: Verify visual contrast of text against background meets 4.5:1 for regular text and 3:1 for large text.

Message: Document has no interactive controls or links requiring tab navigation.
Evidence: No links or form widgets detected.
Remediation: Ensure page tab navigation follows document structure order.

Message: No timed transitions, automated page flips, or timeouts detected.
Remediation: Do not set automated timeouts or slide transitions without user pause controls.

Message: No flashing or rapid animated content detected in the document.
Remediation: Avoid animations or blinking content that flashes more than three times in any one-second period.

Message: Document has a descriptive title: 'Annual Accessibility and Technology Report 2026'.
Remediation: Set document title, provide bookmarks for long documents, and write descriptive link text.

Message: No input modality conflicts detected with touch or pointer gestures.
Remediation: Ensure visible text labels match accessible names.

Message: Language of document is specified as 'en-US'.
Remediation: Set default document language and mark language switches.

Message: Interactive fields and links operate predictably without unexpected context changes.
Evidence: Action triggers conform to standard behavior.
Remediation: Avoid automated submit actions or context jumps when form fields receive focus.

Message: No interactive form fields found in document.
Remediation: Provide clear tooltips (/TU) or accessible labels for all interactive form fields.

Message: Document semantic tagging and extraction permissions are compatible with assistive technology.
Evidence: Tagged PDF with accessibility permissions enabled.
Remediation: Ensure all interactive elements have accessible names and standard structural roles.

Message: Heading hierarchy is logically consistent across all 1 heading(s).
Remediation: Adjust heading levels in your authoring tool so they increment smoothly without skipping levels.

Message: No data tables found in document.
Remediation: Ensure table cells align evenly and provide descriptive column and row headers.

Message: No hyperlinks found in document.
Remediation: Replace vague labels like 'click here' or bare URLs with clear descriptions of the destination.

Message: No figures present requiring AI semantic evaluation.
Remediation: Write concise, descriptive alt text that explains what the image illustrates without saying 'image of' or 'graphic of'.

Message: Flesch Reading Ease score: 0.0/100 (Very Complex / Specialized). Avg sentence length: 19.5 words.
Remediation: Simplify sentence structures and reduce jargon where possible for broad audience comprehension.

Message: Document structural outline and navigation elements are well-proportioned.
Remediation: Synchronize document bookmarks with the heading hierarchy.
